strings.zh: 遗迹中发现了奇怪的{NEWLINE}拼版。在拼完后突然{NEWLINE}地上出现一个洞,{NEWLINE}我掉了进去！{NEWLINE}真不愧是古代遗迹啊,{NEWLINE}居然还有这种机关。
strings.en: Found a strange puzzle in the{NEWLINE}ruins. Solved it, and suddenly a{NEWLINE}hole opened up in the ground{NEWLINE}and I dropped into the room{NEWLINE}below! Should have known that{NEWLINE}ancient ruins would have{NEWLINE}surprising tricks like that.

strings.zh: 掉下去的地方是个{NEWLINE}摆放着石像的大厅,而且{NEWLINE}突然未知图腾就出现了。{NEWLINE}也就是说那个石板拼图是{NEWLINE}唤醒未知图腾的钥匙。{NEWLINE}这遗迹还蛮难解的。
strings.en: I fell into a hall lined with stone{NEWLINE}statues, and suddenly the Unown{NEWLINE}appeared. So that stone puzzle{NEWLINE}was the key that woke the Unown.{NEWLINE}These ruins are quite a riddle.

strings.zh: 在遗迹中打开收音机{NEWLINE}会收到一种未知的{NEWLINE}电波。这是未知图腾之间{NEWLINE}以电波进行联络对话的{NEWLINE}强有力证明。
strings.en: If you turn on the radio in the{NEWLINE}ruins, you can receive mysterious{NEWLINE}radio waves! It’s proof that the{NEWLINE}Unown communicate with each{NEWLINE}other using radio waves!

strings.zh: 已知未知图腾有与英文字母{NEWLINE}一样多的种类。已确认的{NEWLINE}字母有２６个,而已确认的{NEWLINE}未知图腾种类也是２６种,{NEWLINE}也就是说未知图腾总共有{NEWLINE}２６种,能全部抓齐吗？
strings.en: There are as many Unown as there{NEWLINE}are letters in the alphabet.{NEWLINE}Right now, we’re confirming the{NEWLINE}existence of 26 kinds of Unown.{NEWLINE}Do you think you can find{NEWLINE}all 26 of them?

strings.zh: 现在知道未知图腾也是{NEWLINE}有顺序的了。{NEWLINE}自然界存在的一切事物看似{NEWLINE}四分五裂其实都是有自己的{NEWLINE}规律的。
strings.en: Now we know the Unown have an{NEWLINE}order, too. Everything in nature{NEWLINE}may look scattered and random,{NEWLINE}but in truth, it all follows{NEWLINE}rules of its own.

strings.zh: 将零碎地记录在这笔记上的{NEWLINE}未知图腾,交送给研究所的{NEWLINE}工作人员进行重新排序了。{NEWLINE}这么一来未知图腾的事{NEWLINE}就能了解清楚了。
strings.en: In this report, the scattered{NEWLINE}Unown were sorted and put into{NEWLINE}order by the research-center{NEWLINE}staff. That makes the Unown much{NEWLINE}easier to understand.

strings.zh: 在遗迹里发现了地板上{NEWLINE}刻有未知图腾图案的房间。{NEWLINE}这似乎是个大发现啊！{NEWLINE}研究所的人都很兴奋地{NEWLINE}说要来调查。
strings.en: Scratched on the floor of the{NEWLINE}ruins are Unown letters. Finding{NEWLINE}the room feels like a huge{NEWLINE}discovery! The Researchers were{NEWLINE}very excited and said they were{NEWLINE}going to go check it out.

strings.zh: 未知图腾字母不光２６种,{NEWLINE}还发现了其他的两种。{NEWLINE}就是说未知图腾也还有{NEWLINE}另外的两种。
strings.en: There aren’t just 26 kinds of{NEWLINE}Unown letters. Two more have{NEWLINE}been found! That means there{NEWLINE}are two more kinds of Unown.

strings.zh: {VAR:0204:24}把刻在小房间石板上的{NEWLINE}字母也记录到笔记上了。
strings.en: {VAR:0204:24}The letters carved on the stone{NEWLINE}tablet in the small room have also{NEWLINE}been recorded in the notes.

strings.zh: {VAR:0204:120}现在还不知道{NEWLINE}这到底是什么意思。
strings.en: {VAR:0204:120}We don’t know what this could{NEWLINE}possibly mean yet.

strings.zh: 研究所的人说{NEWLINE}还有必要去遗迹调查{NEWLINE}一下⋯⋯
strings.en: The Researchers were saying{NEWLINE}that they’ll need to examine the{NEWLINE}ruins again, but...?

strings.zh: 看来很久以前就有{NEWLINE}未知图腾和人类{NEWLINE}在此居住了。{NEWLINE}遗迹地下的石像就是{NEWLINE}那些人类制造的。
strings.en: It seems that long ago, Unown{NEWLINE}and humans lived here together.{NEWLINE}The statues beneath the ruins{NEWLINE}were made by those people.

strings.zh: 未知图腾非常胆小,{NEWLINE}基本不离开遗迹。而遗迹旁的{NEWLINE}人类则渐渐地都来了这里,{NEWLINE}希望未知图腾与人类{NEWLINE}能够共存的一族人最后{NEWLINE}离开了这里。
strings.en: The Unown are very timid and{NEWLINE}almost never leave the ruins.{NEWLINE}As more people gradually came{NEWLINE}to live near the ruins, the clan{NEWLINE}who hoped Unown and humans{NEWLINE}could live together finally left.
